name: com.ympp.slash-effect-studio
description: Procedural 2D XY-plane slash/arc VFX editor for Unity. Edit multi-anchor Bezier ribbons with dual-curve width profiles, bake ready-to-use SpriteSheets with automatic Multiple Sprite slicing, and generate XY-plane ParticleSystem objects & prefabs in one click.

samples.description: Demonstrates XY-plane horizontal movement with FlipX and ParticleSystem slash playback.
